title: Revive Us Again

questions.question: Lord, you were favorable to your land; you restored the fortunes of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:1 (ESV): "Lord, you were favorable to your land; you restored the fortunes of Jacob."

questions.question: You forgave the iniquity of your people; you covered all their what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:2 (ESV): "You forgave the iniquity of your people; you covered all their sin."

questions.question: You withdrew all your wrath; you turned from your hot what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:3 (ESV): "You withdrew all your wrath; you turned from your hot anger."

questions.question: Restore us again, O God of our salvation, and put away your indignation toward whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:4 (ESV): "...and put away your indignation toward us!"

questions.question: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger to all what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:5 (ESV): "Will you be angry with us forever? Will you prolong your anger to all generations?"

questions.question: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:6 (ESV): "Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?"

questions.question: Show us your steadfast love, O Lord, and grant us your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:7 (ESV): "Show us your steadfast love, O Lord, and grant us your salvation."

questions.question: Let me hear what God the Lord will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, to his what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:8 (ESV): "...for he will speak peace to his people, to his saints;"

questions.question: But let them not turn back to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:8 (ESV): "...but let them not turn back to folly."

questions.question: Surely his salvation is near to those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:9 (ESV): "...that glory may dwell in our land."

questions.question: Steadfast love and faithfulness meet; righteousness and peace kiss each other. What springs up from the ground?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:11 (ESV): "Faithfulness springs up from the ground,"

questions.question: And righteousness looks down from where?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:11 (ESV): "...and righteousness looks down from the sky."

questions.question: Yes, the Lord will give what is good, and our land will yield its what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:12 (ESV): "...and our land will yield its increase."

questions.question: Righteousness will go before him and make his footsteps a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85:13 (ESV): "Righteousness will go before him and make his footsteps a way."

questions.question: To whom is this Psalm attributed?
questions.explanation: Psalm 85 Title: "To the choirmaster. A Psalm of the Sons of Korah."

key_verse_text: Will you not revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
